scope: Completed root visual review of all three actual geometry-v2 Blender PNGs only. Full ground-eye perspective provides a coherent whole museum view; root also reopened licensed Commons57659417. Curved glazing, high-north and lower-southwest volumes, folded yellow bands, entry sign and forecourt features are legible. Detail shows the closed silver C wrapper, narrow glazed slots, louvers and recessed floor layers. Rear shows continuous glazing, the separate exterior stair and roof terrace. Added repairs cause no obvious visual intrusion at these reviewed scales. Full projection differs explicitly from v1; detail/rear cameras are exactly unchanged.
